# Tax Lien Certificate Sales

Property Sales information is now managed at the [Hamilton County, OH RealAuction website](https://hamilton.sheriffsaleauction.ohio.gov/)

You can also visit the following pages:

[Property Sales](https://www.hcso.org/community-services/search-property-sales/property-sales/)

[Delinquent tax search](https://www.hcso.org/community-services/search-property-sales/delinquent-tax-sales/)

[Sold Foreclosures](https://www.hcso.org/community-services/search-property-sales/sold-foreclosures/)
